text.en: This Order may be cited as the Miscellaneous Licences Act (Amendment) and shall commence on 1st January 2015. of long title of Chapter 12 7.

The long title of the Miscellaneous Licences Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is repealed and the following new long title is substituted therefor make provision for the licensing, regulation and control of certain and certain commercial places and for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto". of section 1.
Section 1 of the Act is amended by deleting "Miscellaneous" from the first line and by substituting "Business" therefor. of section 2.
Section 2 of the Act is repealed and the following new section is substituted "Interpretation.

The Act is amended by inserting the following two new sections after section 2 - ''Licensing authority. 2A. 11} The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, appoint a licensing authority for the purposes of this Act.

(2) The licensing authority shall, subject to any directions of the be responsible for the general supervision of the implementation and the administration of this Act. Authorised officers. 2B. The Minister may by notification published in the Gazette appoint such of authorised officers to carry into effect any specific provisions of this Act or of any regulations made thereunder.". Amendment of section '3.
Section 3 of the Act is amended by deleting "licence" from the third line and by substituting "Business Licence" therefor. Amendment of section 4.
Section 4A of the Act is amended, in subsection [ 1), by deleting "public officer" from the first line and by substituting "person or body" therefor. of section 5.
Section 5 of the Act is amended by deleting "any public officer authorised by the Minister" from the fourth line and by substituting "authorised officer" of new section 5B.

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after SAto close place. 5B. Where the licensing authority has SU;Spended a licence under the licensing authority may, by notice in writing, order the the place to which the licence relates for the duration of the period of suspension.''. of section 6.
Section 6 of the Act is repealed and the following new section is substituted "Offences.

Section 7 of the Act is amended, in subsection (1), by inserting "and, in the case of a continuing offence, to a further fine not exceeding $100 for each day during which the offence continues" immediately after "$10,000" in the last line. of new section 7 A.

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after "Composition of offences. 7 A. ( 1) authority or any person authorised by the licensing in writing in that behalf may compound any offence against this Act or any regulations made thereunder by collecting from the person suspected of having committed the offence a sum of money not exceeding $500.

(2) On payment of such sum of money, no further proceedings shall be taken against such person in respect of the offence.". of section 9.
Section 9 of the Act is amended, in the marginal note, by deleting "Savings" and by substituting "Non-derogation" therefor. of section 10.
Section 10 of the Act is repealed and the following new section is substituted
The Act is amended by adding the following two new sections"Amendment of Schedule.

( 1) application for licences pending to be issued under the Act made the date of commencement of this Order shall be deemed to be an for a Business Licence.

(2) Any licence issued under the Act and in force immediately before the date of commencement of this Order shall continue to. be in force for the remaining period of the licence and shall subsist until its expiry.

(3) Any public officer declared to be an authorised officer under the the date of of this Order shall continue to be authorised officers under the Act as if the public officer had been appointed under section 2B of the Act. Made this 6th. day of Rabiulawal, 1436 Hijriah corresponding to the 28th. day of December, 2014 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
